programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Birthday Huff
programs.desc: It's Max the cat's birthday but Nikhil and Jay are in a huff with each other. Amma and Appa try to get them to say sorry to each other, but it is just too hard.

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: At the playground, Daniel wants to swing as high as Jodi. Nana teaches Daniel that he's big enough now to try it himself!

programs.title: Mittens & Pants
programs.desc: Post Pig Petunia's mail van has broken down. Mittens tries to help her fix it, but it's no use. Now how will the mail get delivered? By hitching a ride on another vehicle, but which one?

programs.title: BeddyByes
programs.desc: MeMo and BaBa explore all types of connections: daisy chains, little cars, holding hands. They discover that there are many ways to connect on the wonderful Planet BeddyByes.

programs.title: Mixmups
programs.desc: When the Mixmups spy a rainbow in the Sky, they go on an adventure to find out what lies at the end of it.

programs.title: Ready Eddie Go!
programs.desc: Eddie shares his love of astronomy with Akil during an evening of stargazing. Together, they spot constellations and planets, and Eddie learns to share his special interest.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: When Bluey accidentally makes Bingo upset playing a game at dinner, she will do anything to make her happy again - even changing the rules of the game. But nothing seems to work.

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Brrrmm, brmmm, here we go! Fizzy and Suds get up to speed in the workshop and learn all about fast cars. Let's see how they get spray-painted!

programs.title: The Makery
programs.desc: Nim and The Makery are having a vegetable growing competition. They also create a paper plate dinosaur picture, a pastry carrot and a burger costume.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Get ready for a Wiggly circus! Join in the fun with the 'Doing a Handstand' sing-along, and you can dance too! We're delighted to welcome Atsuko Arai, singing the beautiful song 'Haru Ga Kita.

programs.title: Andy's Global Adventures
programs.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Thailand on a global adventure in search of purple swamphens.

programs.title: Mojo Swoptops
programs.desc: Mojo and Bo have to figure out a way to get Felix off a cliff ledge!
